about_the_game:
SPACE WALK puts you in the role of a lone astronaut living aboard A.S.T.R.A. Station, your home among the stars. As part of ASTRA’s pioneering program, you’ll explore the wonders of our solar system—surveying distant landscapes, analyzing celestial phenomena, and uncovering the mysteries of the cosmos.

From the quiet vastness of space to the alien beauty of planetary surfaces, SPACE WALK offers a deeply immersive experience where every discovery is hands-on. Deploy research equipment, navigate low-gravity environments, and adapt to the challenges of each world you visit.

With a focus on exploration and environmental storytelling, SPACE WALK invites you to carve out a life beyond Earth. Every journey brings new sights, untold stories, and the promise of discovery in the endless frontier.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Space Exploration: 

    Explore the wonders of our solar system, from the lunar surface to the rings of Saturn. Traverse uncharted landscapes, witness breathtaking cosmic phenomena, and experience the vastness of space like never before.

  • Gravity

    Outside the station, you’ll float in zero gravity, while artificial gravity keeps you steady inside. Every planet has its own unique pull, from the Moon’s light gravity to the immense forces of gas giants.

  • A Place To Call Home:

    The fabricator lets you personalize your station with decorations and utilities. From essential gear to personal touches, make your station feel like home as you explore the solar system.

  • Interactive Physics Environment:

    Almost every object can be interacted with. Perform hands-on tasks, operate machinery, and experience the challenge of managing a dynamic physics-based environment, where low and zero gravity add unique complexities to every action.

  • Space Station Maintenance:

    Ensure A.S.T.R.A Station remains functional by handling repairs, system reboots, and calibrations. From managing solar panels to overseeing life support, your efforts are essential to keeping the station operational.

  • Tools And Equipment:

    As you navigate the station and the planetary surfaces, you’ll discover a variety of tools essential for survival and mission success. Each tool offers unique ways to interact with your environment.

content_descriptors.notes: SPACE WALK contains themes of isolation, survival, and existential dread, with moments designed to evoke tension and unease. Players may encounter situations involving injury (e.g., concussions, limb damage) and environmental hazards that contribute to a sense of peril. Its dark and mysterious atmosphere, combined with certain story elements, may be unsettling to some players. I recommend this game for mature audiences who are comfortable with thriller and suspense themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970/1650 / AMD Radeon R9 290X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-9900K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: SPACE WALK is a first-person sci-fi experience that immerses you in the life of an astronaut. Discover the wonders of the solar system, navigate low and zero gravity, and operate your very own space station—your home among the stars.
